name: VT secondary phase-rotation reference
summary: Preserves the identified phase sequence through the secondary voltage measurement circuit.
description: Preserves the identified phase sequence through the secondary voltage measurement circuit. A voltage-transformer secondary arrangement connects a defined primary voltage measurement to protection, metering or control inputs. Winding identity, fuse protection and the voltage reference must remain visible across the drawing.

In a substation bay, one voltage circuit can feed protection while a separately identified winding supplies metering. A voltage-selection circuit must make clear which bus or line measurement is being used. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Phase-labelled VT signals” at the input and “Consistent phase rotation” at the output. Labels need verification against the connection diagram.

Show the primary measurement point, secondary connection, protective devices and relay reference. A missing measurement can resemble a real system disturbance unless the voltage-circuit health is supervised appropriately. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
